title: Navimower 0.4.7-beta3

## Numeric MQTT state semantics

This beta removes the remaining ambiguity around the official location channel's numeric `vehicleState=3`.

Field evidence from H215 and independent community implementations shows that numeric state 3 can accompany both vendor Idle (`0103/isIdel`) and Paused (`0211/isPaused`). It is therefore treated only as a coarse pause/idle hint:

- numeric 3 no longer means Charging;
- numeric 3 no longer counts as a docked state;
- numeric 3 does not force Paused by itself;
- canonical Idle, Paused, Docked and Charging continue to come from the stronger private/named vendor state;
- Navimower Schedule now recognizes Charging only from canonical vendor Charging (`0102`) instead of the numeric pose hint.

This keeps the existing public state model intact while removing a contradictory internal Charging path.

## Per-type MQTT source-time arbitration

Navimow location sub-messages can arrive late or out of order. Arrival time is no longer allowed to make an older semantic packet look fresh.

The location parser now keeps an independent source-time high-water mark for message types 1-4:

- type 1: live pose / numeric state;
- type 2: current mowing boundary, route/work progress and packed work data;
- type 3: selected partition/task set;
- type 4: task delay / coarse state.

A packet whose vendor source timestamp is older than the already accepted timestamp for the same type is rejected before semantic merge.

Important behavior:

- equal timestamps remain accepted for compatibility with partial/duplicate vendor updates;
- messages without a usable source timestamp remain accepted as a compatibility fallback;
- a rejected late packet cannot rewind position, zone, work target, progress, partition selection or task delay;
- rejected packets cannot refresh state/action/target freshness merely because they arrived now;
- transport health still sees that MQTT traffic arrived, while semantic freshness remains tied to accepted source data.

This directly hardens the field-observed zone 36 -> 37 handoff case: a delayed older zone-36 report can no longer overwrite a newer accepted zone-37 observation.

## Diagnostics

Public Home Assistant diagnostics now expose value-safe MQTT ordering metadata:

- latest accepted source timestamp per location message type;
- cumulative late-rejected count per type;
- message types accepted/rejected in the latest parsed batch.

No raw MQTT payloads or mower coordinates are added to public diagnostics.

## Unchanged

- MQTT keepalive remains unchanged in this beta.
- `mapWorkPosition` decoding is not broadened.
- Target zone and Planned zones remain separate concepts.
- ZoneLedger, VendorTrailStore, map handling and Map Card contracts are unchanged.
- The prerelease-only `navimower.export_raw_data` maintainer action remains available.
